verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks (webhooks) that notify a developer's system when jobs finish. The Socket API (Socket.io real-time task updates) is a related push mechanism, but it is a client-held socket connection rather than a callback to the developer's endpoint, so it earns no credit. Zapier integration is likewise adjacent.

support.subject: As a developer, finished jobs notify my system by callback instead of making me poll
